methodologyNotes: Roster covers nine high-search digital kitchen scale models spanning budget through prosumer tiers: OXO Good Grips Stainless Steel (pull-out display), Escali Primo P115, Greater Goods (Nourish/Nutrition backlit), KitchenAid KQ909, Etekcity EK6015, My Weigh KD-8000, Zwilling Enfinigy, Ozeri Pronto ZK14, and Nicewell 22lb. Specs independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages (oxo.com, escaliusa.com/atbbq.com, shop.greatergoods.com, etekcity.com, zwilling.com, ozeri.com, hbitech.com) and major retail/review listings (Amazon, Walmart, Home Depot, Tom's Guide, thecookingworld.com, scalesplus.com, toolsandtoys.net). precision_g in grams (standard metric increment); max_weight_kg in kilograms; booleans reflect manufacturer/authoritative-review yes/no; dishwasher_safe=false recorded when manufacturer states wipe/hand-wash only, true only when a removable platform is explicitly dishwasher-safe, null when unstated. Prices are published US prices for the exact model/config named; where no live USD price could be confirmed, priceUsd=null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.provenance: The etekcity.com official ESN00 product page confirms the weight capacity (176.4 oz / 11 lb / 5000 g / 5000 mL, i.e. 5 kg), 1 g increments (weighs 3 g-5000 g), units (oz / lb:oz / g / mL), a Tare button, a food-grade 304 stainless steel weighing platform, "3 x 1.5V AAA Batteries", and a $39.99 regular price. Battery quantity note: the manufacturer Product Specifications table states 3 AAA (used here as authoritative); the VeSync In-the-Box list says 2 pre-installed AAA, a minor discrepancy left unresolved in favor of the manufacturer spec. display type is left blank (only a "Backlight Auto-Off" setting is listed; neither page states the display technology such as LCD/LED), dishwasher safe is left blank (only "easy-to-clean" is claimed, with no dishwasher/immersion guidance), and release date is left blank (no release date published on either fetched page). Adversarial re-fetch of both URLs confirmed every recorded spec value, the price, and the null release date verbatim; no values required nulling.

products.name: Taylor Multi-Purpose Digital Kitchen Scale (3831S)
products.priceNote: $29.99 listed on the taylorusa.com official product page (shown as "Sale price $29.99"; the regular price was blank). The Amazon listing (ASIN B01N06M3L5) showed "No featured offers available" (no US price) at access, served in a EUR locale, so price is sourced from the manufacturer store.
products.provenance: The official taylorusa.com product page (titled "Multi-Purpose Digital Kitchen Scale | 3831S | TAYLOR") confirms verbatim the tempered glass platform, up to 6.6-pound capacity, a "large 0.7 LCD display," "Auto shut off & tare features," "One (1) CR2032 battery included," and "Handwash only. Do not immerse it in water or put it in the dishwasher" (dishwasher safe=false); it lists a price of "Sale price $29.99." The Amazon listing (ASIN B01N06M3L5, Part Number 3831S, UPC 077784005859) corroborates the exact 3831S model and states "6.6lb/3kg capacity" (max weight (kg)=3), "Measurement Type Pounds/Ounces, Kilograms/Grams" (unit modes g, oz, lb, kg), "Electronic Tare" (tare=true), "Material Type Glass" (platform material tempered glass per the manufacturer page), and "Readout Accuracy 0.1 ounce/1 gram" plus product description "weighs in 0.1oz/1g increments" and "kilograms to 1g" (precision (g)=1). precision (g)=1 follows the three consistent Amazon "1 gram" statements; the manufacturer page's phrase ".1-ounce/.1-gram" appears to be a copy typo (0.1 oz pairs with 1 g division, not 0.1 g) and was not used. Amazon showed no US price ("No featured offers available"), so the price is sourced from the taylorusa.com store; no release date is stated on either fetched page, so release date is left blank. Re-fetch (2026-07-10) reconfirmed every value above verbatim.

products.name: Joseph Joseph TriScale Compact Folding Digital Kitchen Scale
products.priceNote: $36.00 on kettleandcord.com (verbatim "Sale price $36.00"), a US retailer at 390 Kingston Ave, Brooklyn, NY, 11225, for the White TriScale (SKU 40071). The manufacturer page eu.josephjoseph.com lists 44,99€ (EUR, not USD) for the same White SKU. The listed price is the unambiguously-US kettleandcord figure.

specs.unit_modes: g, lb, oz, fl oz, mL

products.provenance: Both fetched pages confirm the White TriScale (SKU 40071), the exact model — not a sibling or other capacity. eu.josephjoseph.com titles it "TriScale™ Digital White Kitchen Scales" with "SKU: (White) 40071"; kettleandcord.com titles it "Joseph Joseph TriScale Compact Folding Digital Scale, White". Both state verbatim the "easy-to-read LCD display" (display type=LCD), "touch-sensitive controls and auto power-off", the "Add & Weigh function [that] allows multiple ingredients to be measured in the same bowl during recipe preparation" (tare=true — Add & Weigh is the scale's tare/re-zero function), and the units "gms, lbs, ozs, fl.ozs and mls" (unit modes). kettleandcord additionally states "Maximum capacity: 5kg/176.4 fl.oz/11lb/5000ml" (max weight (kg)=5) at "Sale price $36.00" (US retailer, Brooklyn NY). The source's care line "Wipe clean with a damp cloth" backs dishwasher safe=false per this roster's wipe/hand-wash-only convention. power source was removed on re-verification: the specific "1 x CR2032 battery (included)" value appears in neither fetched page (the prior entry attributed it to gohailo.com, which is not the recorded source or corroboration URL; only a customer review mentions a "battery cover", not a CR2032), so it fails verbatim support. precision (g) and platform material stay blank (no graduation/division or platform-material statement in either fetched page), and release date stays blank (no release year published on either page). The page this record originally cited (https://eu.josephjoseph.com/products/triscale-white) has been retired: on 2026-09-10 it answered 200 but redirected to https://eu.josephjoseph.com/, the site's own front door, from a datacenter connection and a residential one alike. Its second recorded capture of the same figures — kettleandcord.com, read 2026-07-10 — is the source now, and this record no longer claims an independent corroboration.
